newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Foreign JVs in China A-shrs to use domestic funds.
newsitem.headline: Foreign JVs in China A-shrs to use domestic funds.

text.p: Foreign joint ventures permitted to participate in trading of China's A-shares would use domestic funds to invest in the market, a senior People's Bank of China (PBOC) official said on Tuesday.

"They can raise funds from the domestic (market) and invest in A-shares. The foreign partner of the company just brings technology and their know-how," the PBOC's deputy governor Chen Yuan told a news conference in Hong Kong.
He said the participation of a "very few joint-venture fund management companies" in the A-share market, which is reserved for domestic investors, would be "on an experimental basis".
Beijing-backed Hong Kong newspaper Wen Wei Po quoted Chen on Tuesday as saying regulations governing Sino-foreign joint venture investment funds would be issued early next year.
These would include rules allowing foreign joint venture funds to invest in the A-share market.
